notes.title: May 4th Patch
notes.notes:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/289760/discussions/0/540740501043655980/]Build 4368[/url] is now live in the store and features an all new epic track from our very own [url=http://basstreblemusic.com/]Ben Lam[/url]!

We've also got a few fixes on the back-end to help with controller compatibility.

See you on the launchpad!
